description: NaLa(SeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.51 Å. La is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.87 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.70 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) Se-O bond length. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.70 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) Se-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Se atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLa₂Se tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Se atom.
